## Phase: 26 - Memory & Harness Hardening

### Memory supersession API
from: [[wiki:memory-mcp-api]]
retrieved: 2026-05-23

- memory_forget(memory_id, superseded_by="", scope="project") -- soft delete with optional supersession chain
- memory_prune only targets trust='low' + strength=1; bridge/harvest entries are trust='medium'/'high' so prune is dead code for them
- SearchResult schema: {"memory": {"id": "mem_xxx", "content": "...", "tags": [...]}, "score": N} -- result["memory"]["id"] needed for supersede

### Memory supersede at harness layer
from: [[decision:memory-supersede-harness-layer]]
retrieved: 2026-05-23

- Wire memory_forget with superseded_by at harness layer, not vendor code
- 10-call cap per bridge run, 1 supersede per decision max
- Search existing bridge-decisions for same phase-slug before storing new

### Crash recovery dual condition
from: [[decision:crash-recovery-dual-condition]]
retrieved: 2026-05-23

- Dual condition: commits newer than _CURRENT_STATE.md mtime AND no debrief commit in recent history
- Advisory only (exit 0), guarded by test -f .dev-wiki/_CURRENT_STATE.md
- Hook exit codes: 0=allow, 2=block; advisory hooks MUST exit 0
